care.water: Allow the top inch of soil to dry out between waterings. Water less frequently in winter.
care.light: Thrives in bright, indirect light but can tolerate low light conditions. Avoid direct sunlight which can scorch leaves.
care.soil: Use a well-draining potting mix. Adding perlite can help with drainage.
care.toxicity: Toxic to pets and humans if ingested. Keep out of reach of children and animals.

varieties.name: Neon Pothos
varieties.description: Showstopping variety with bright, electric chartreuse-green leaves.

care.light: Bright indirect light to maintain color. Turns darker green in low light.
care.water: Allow top inch of soil to dry out.

varieties.name: Jade Pothos
varieties.description: The original Pothos with solid, deep green heart-shaped leaves.

care.light: Low to Medium indirect light. Can tolerate lower light than variegated types.
care.water: Let soil dry out between waterings.

varieties.name: Marble Queen Pothos
varieties.description: Highly speckled leaves with a mix of green and creamy white.

care.light: Bright indirect light. variegation slows photosynthesis, so it needs more light.

varieties.name: Hawaiian Pothos
varieties.description: Similar to golden pothos but with much larger leaves and intense yellow variegation.

varieties.name: Golden Pothos
varieties.description: The classic houseplant with green leaves splashed with golden yellow.

care.light: Low to Bright indirect light. Adaptable.

varieties.name: Manjula Pothos
varieties.description: Patented variety with wide, wavy leaves featuring swirls of cream, silver, white, and green.

care.light: Bright indirect light is essential to keep the white areas from browning.
care.water: Keep consistently moist but not soggy.

varieties.name: Pearls and Jade Pothos
varieties.description: Smaller leaves with white edges and green centers, speckled with grey and green.

care.water: Allow top inch to dry. Sensitive to overwatering.

varieties.name: N'Joy Pothos
varieties.description: Distinct white and green patches. Unlike Pearls and Jade, the white parts are usually solid without speckling.

care.water: Let dry out slightly more than other varieties.

varieties.name: Global Green Pothos
varieties.description: Green-on-green variegation with a dark green border and lighter lime center.

varieties.name: Snow Queen Pothos
varieties.description: A highly variegated form of Marble Queen with more white than green.

care.light: Bright indirect light required to maintain the white.

varieties.name: Cebu Blue Pothos
varieties.description: Silvery-blue, lance-shaped leaves that can fenestrate (split) as they mature and climb.

care.light: Bright indirect light. Needs more light than standard pothos to maintain blue hue.

varieties.name: Jessenia Pothos
varieties.description: Similar to Marble Queen but with lime green variegation instead of white.

varieties.name: Baltic Blue Pothos
varieties.description: Dark blue-green leaves that fenestrate earlier than Cebu Blue.

varieties.name: Shangri-La Pothos
varieties.description: Unusual 'sleeping' pothos with curled, spinach-like leaves.
